title: DRIFTWOOD | Seagrove Beach, FL | Five Star Properties
meta_description: Driftwood - Vacation Rental in Seagrove Beach with Beach ViewsFavorite Features:- Gulf View- Community Pool- Close Proximity...
description_expanded: Driftwood - Vacation Rental in Seagrove Beach with Beach Views Favorite Features: - Gulf View - Community Pool - Close Proximity to Seaside - 4 Bikes Included - 3 Min Walk To Beach  - Golf Cart More About Driftwood: Driftwood is a spectacularly-built home, located near Seaside, FL. The home is named for the unique and natural flooring throughout and is exceptionally well designed and thoughtful. Every detail and amenity, from the flooring made of reclaimed lumber to the highly stylized marble countertops, make this a top-notch destination. Driftwood creates a luxurious home filled with casual coastal elegance and true Southern charm. The cozy porch swing offers guests a heartfelt invitation to relax and enjoy a glass of lemonade. Once inside, you will notice the distinguished board and batten walls, as well as beautiful flooring made of dark, reclaimed lumber. You can also enjoy a relaxing bike ride to the neighboring Seaside and Seagrove Beach with the four bikes that come with this rental. The living area boasts a 60-inch flat-screen LCD television and comfortable seating. The gourmet kitchen is complete with BOSCH appliances, marble countertops, and a spacious island with bar seating. The formal dining room seats eight.   Past the first-floor powder room is a luxurious tropical oasis. The Brazilian hardwood deck has plenty of room to relax as well as a dining room table. The gas grill uses fuel from the property’s gas line, so guests never have to worry about running out of propane. Palm trees, banana trees, lemon, lime, and Valencia orange trees add an additional layer of privacy to the deck area.   The second floor is home to most of the property’s well-appointed bedrooms. The queen Jack and Jill bedrooms share a spa-inspired bathroom, complete with a rain head shower, marble vanities, and marble flooring. Both bedrooms are decorated in soothing grays and creams and are equipped with flat-screen televisions. The first master king suite is designed with a large walk-in closet, and natural wood furniture, creating a serene, relaxing, atmosphere. The bathroom is equipped with his and her sinks, a large, stand-alone shower with a rain head, a garden tub, and marble counters. The bathroom is also designed with a water closet, adding an additional note of luxury and privacy to the space. The laundry room boasts a great view of the water, as well as high capacity Samsung appliances and marble counters.   The third floor is home to the “family suite”. A king master bedroom boasts a small outdoor balcony with an amazing view of the Gulf and a 42-inch flat-screen television. The suite shares a bathroom with a custom-designed bunk room, which sleeps eight. The lower bunks are both doubles, and the upper bunks are both doubles as well. The furniture was custom designed by a decorator, and are guaranteed to meet all safety codes. Each bunk has its own 22-inch flat-screen television, DVD player.   Close to the action on 30-A and a short walk to the beach, Driftwood provides guests with a peaceful and luxurious oasis designed with casual, coastal elegance in mind. The lovely community pool is directly across from the home and the beach access is a 2-3 minute walk from the front door.   The home also features 4 bicycles for your use. Tour Seagrove and the neighboring community of Seaside. You are able to bike to many of the best eateries and locations along 30A. *All TV's stream through owner-provided YouTube TV Sleeping Arrangements: SECOND FLOOR Bedroom 1: King Bed & Ensuite Bathroom with Shower & Soaking Tub. Bedroom 2: Queen Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 3: Queen Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. THIRD FLOOR Bedroom 4: 2 Full over Full Bunk Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower. Bedroom 5: King Bed & Shared Ensuite Bathroom with Shower.
